αἰζηῶν: αἰζηός — vigorous young man; masc. gen. pl.: ’young men’
αἲ: αἴ (epic = εἰ) — if, would that; particle introducing a wish + opt. (αἲ γάρ ’would that’)
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὐτὼ: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. dual: ’the two themselves’
αὖτέ: αὖτε — again, now in turn; adv., accented αὖτέ before the enclitic μιν
βίη: βίη — might, bodily strength, force; fem. nom. sg.
βασιλῆος: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic βασιλέως)
βουλῇ: βουλή — counsel, plan, council; fem. dat. sg. (ἐν βουλῇ ’in council’)
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a condition after εἰ: ’should become’
γέρας: γέρας — prize of honour, privilege, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg.: ’old man!’
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γήθησεν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= γήθησε)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γερήνιος: Γερήνιος — Gerenian, standing epithet of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.; meaning uncertain — perhaps from a place Gerenia, or linked to γέρας ’honour’
γερόντων: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. pl.
γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg.
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. gen. sg., after ἐδεύετο: ’lacked the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. depending on ἦδος: ’pleasure of the feast’
δαῖτα: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. acc. sg.: ’for the feast’ (after κατά), ’a meal’ (object of τετύκοντο)
διογενὲς: διογενής — Zeus-born, sprung from Zeus; masc. voc. sg.
διοτρεφέος: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
διοτρεφέων: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured; masc. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῶν)
δόσαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. acc. sg.
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; potential with κεν: ’it would be’
εἵπετο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 sg., with augment εἵ- (= ἐ- + ἕπετο)
εὗρ: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 sg., elided (εὗρ’ = εὗρε): ’found’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’)
κελεύσω: κελεύω — urge, command, bid; fut. 1 sg. (or short-vowel aor. subj.): ’I shall bid’
κερδαλεόφρον: κερδαλεόφρων — gain-minded, crafty in profit; masc. voc. sg.
κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
κύπελλα: κύπελλον — cup, drinking-vessel; neut. acc. pl.
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg.; as accusative of respect, χωόμενος κῆρ ’incensed in heart’ · also κήρ — doom, death-fate; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’
λαερτιάδη: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; voc. sg.
λαὸν: λαός — people, host; masc. acc. sg.
λαὸς: λαός — people, host, army; masc. nom. sg.
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’)
μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἔσχοντο: ’from the fighting’
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big; masc. acc. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’)
μέσσον: μέσος — middle, in the middle; neut. acc. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic μέσον), used as a noun: ’the middle’
μίμνετε: μίμνω — stay, remain (= Attic μένω); pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’stay!’
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after; + acc.: ’to, among’ (motion) · also + dat.: ’among’ (μετ’ ἀθανάτοισιν) · also + acc., ’next after’ (μετ’ ἀμύμονα Πηλεΐωνα)
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis
μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ), with an imperative: ’and do not’ · also with an optative of wish: ’and let … not’ (μηδ’ ἔτι … εἴην ’and may I no longer be’) · also with a hortatory subj.: ’and let us not’ (μηδ’ … ἀμβαλλώμεθα ’and let us not put off’)
μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., used with an imperative to forbid: ’and let not’
μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj. with an imperative (prohibition) · also ’and not’ with an infinitive after a verb of bidding (παύεσθαι κέλομαι, μηδὲ … πολεμίζειν)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νέον: νέος — young, new; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’lately, just now’
νέστωρ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
νείκεσσεν: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented, ν-movable
νηλέϊ: νηλεής — pitiless, ruthless; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic νηλεεῖ), agreeing with χαλκῷ
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον)
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἶδε: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 sg. with present force: ’knows’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλαμὸν: οὐλαμός — crowd, throng (of men); masc. acc. sg.
οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’; masc. acc. pl. (οὓς παῖδας ’his own sons’)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτέ: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj., accented οὔτέ before an enclitic
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.: ’neither … nor’
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα)
πεποιθὼς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα: trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’trusting’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περθομένη: πέρθω — sack, destroy; pres. part. pass. fem. nom. sg.: ’being sacked’
πετεῶο: Πετεώς — Peteos, father of Menestheus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οο (= Attic -ῶ)
πλησίον: πλησίος — near, neighbouring; neut. acc. sg. as adv. πλησίον: ’near, beside’; ἐς πλησίον ἄλλον ’to another next to him’
ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
πολέας: πολύς — much, many; masc./fem. acc. pl., epic πολέας (= Attic πολλούς)
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολυμήχαν: πολυμήχανος — of many devices, resourceful; masc. voc. sg., elided (πολυμήχαν’ = πολυμήχανε)
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many counsels, very wily, epithet of Odysseus (μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προμάχοισι: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρόσθ: πρόσθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., elided πρόσθ’ (= πρόσθε): ’before (the others)’
πρότεροι: πρότερος — earlier, first (comparative of πρό); masc. nom. pl., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πρῶτ: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (πρῶτ’ = πρῶτα): ’first, at first’
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πυλίων: Πύλιος — Pylian, of Pylos; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Pylians’
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. acc. sg.
πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στίχες: στίξ — rank, line of men; fem. nom. pl.
σφεας: σφεῖς — they; epic acc. pl. pron. (= Attic σφᾶς): ’them’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σφῶϊ: σφώ — you two; dual pron., epic σφῶϊ, acc.: ’you two’
σφῶϊν: σύ (dual σφῶϊ) — you two; dual gen./dat. 2nd person, epic (= Attic σφῷν): ’of you two’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ’these things’
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τηλεμάχοιο: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο: Τηλεμάχοιο πατήρ ’father of Telemachus’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this one; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’)
φάλαγγες: φάλαγξ — battle-line, line of battle; fem. nom. pl.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φαίνετ: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; pres. 3 sg. mid., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνεται): ’appears’ · also impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνετο): ’was appearing’
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing; with the opt., potential: ’would’
χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
χωομένοιο: χώομαι — be incensed, be angry; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνθρώποισιν: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀϋτῆς: ἀϋτή — shout, battle-cry; fem. gen. sg., with σχοίατο: ’(refrain) from shouting’
ἁλοῦσά: ἁλίσκομαι — be taken, be captured; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε: ’having been taken’
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄνευθεν: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart, aside, at a distance; adv.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη) · also by metonymy ’war’ (πολύδακρυν Ἄρηα ’tearful war’)
ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’which things’
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐγείρομεν: ἐγείρω — rouse, awaken; pres. subj. 1 pl. act., short vowel, in a purpose clause after ὄφρα κε: ’that we may rouse’
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐθέλῃσθα: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ending -ῃσθα (= Attic ἐθέλῃς)
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’)
ἐπέοικε: ἐπέοικα (ἐπείκω) — be fitting, befit; perf. 3 sg., present sense, impersonal: ’it befits’
ἐρχόμενον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’coming’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’
ἐόντας: εἰμί — be; pres. part. acc. pl. masc., epic (= Attic ὄντας)
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑσταότ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότα, Attic ἑστηκότα): ’standing’
ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. acc. pl.
ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχειν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. inf.
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἕποιτο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid. dep., potential with κε: ’would follow’
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, bulwark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἕστασαν: ἵστημι — stand; plpf. 3 pl., intransitive (= Attic εἱστήκεσαν): ’stood, were standing’ (reduplicated ἑ-στα-σαν)
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἠμύσειε: ἠμύω — sink down, bow, collapse; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., potential with κε: ’would collapse’
ἡμετέρῃσιν: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), agreeing with χερσίν
ἤπια: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly, soothing; neut. acc. pl.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἰδών: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having seen’
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰὸν: ἰός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (a different word from ἰός ’poison, rust’)
ἱπποδάμων: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; adj., masc. gen. pl.
ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης)
ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
ἵπποισιν: ἵππος — horse; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic ἵπποις)
ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὑπό: ὑπό — under, beneath; preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑπό … ἔλλαβε ’seized from beneath’); accented before the enclitic τε
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
